facilis

facilis, facile

adjective, third declension; comparative facilior, superlative facillimus

easy

In this lexicon

  • easy

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Heaut. 1058–1059: ubi cognōris, facilia; Caes. BG 1.6.2: iter multō facilius atque expedītius (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • Haec dum incipiās gravia sunt, dumque ignōrēs: ubi cognōris, facilia.

    These things are hard while you are starting and don’t know them; once you know them, they are easy.Ter. Heaut. 1058–1059

    In the entry for easy

  • ‘facilia’ inquit ‘mē docē’. cui praeceptor ‘ista’ inquit ‘omnibus eadem sunt, aequē difficilia’

    ‘Teach me the easy things,’ he said; and his teacher said, ‘These are the same for everyone, and just as hard.’Sen. Ep. 91.17
